title: Nutty Rich Croatian Popcorn Pudding
description: A rich and creamy Croatian dessert featuring toffee popcorn and confit tomato, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings. This dish is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, sugar, and salt, and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
Remove the mixture from the heat and stir in the crushed toffee popcorn and diced confit tomato.
Let the mixture steep for 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a large bowl, pressing on the solids to extract as much liquid as possible.
Whisk in the vanilla extract and melted butter until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold the whipped cream into the pudding mixture until no white streaks remain.
Pour the pudding into individual serving cups and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with additional crushed toffee popcorn and confit tomato if desired.
